[workspace.package]
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
authors = ["Apeireth Team"]
license = "Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/apeireth/apeireth-rust"
description = "Apeireth R14 Rust 重写 — 立体架构 v2 + 生命架构 v4/v4.1 + 17 crate 本源推导 + 双洋葱统一体 + Self-Disable 防护"
homepage = "https://github.com/apeireth/apeireth-rust"
keywords = ["ai", "agent", "autopoietic", "principle-onion", "permission-onion"]
categories = ["ai", "asynchronous", "compilers"]

[workspace.dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1.40", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
anyhow = "1.0"
thiserror = "1.0"
# HTTP 客户端 (含 stream feature, 给 TUI 改瘦 Step 1 的 SSE 流式用)
reqwest = { version = "0.12", default-features = false, features = ["json", "rustls-tls", "stream"] }
# async stream utilities (SSE 解析依赖 StreamExt)
futures = "0.3"

# PyO3 (仅 apeireth-pybridge feature flag, 不进核心依赖)
pyo3 = { version = "0.29", features = ["auto-initialize"] }
# rusqlite 锁到 0.32 (workspace 级硬锁, 防 V2 各 crate libsqlite3-sys links 冲突)。
# 所有用 SQLite 的 crate (memory / vector / api / mcp) 必须写 `rusqlite = { workspace = true }`,
# 禁止各 crate 钉自己的 minor/patch 版本。fix(R19/V1266 code_reviewer-audit): 统一 workspace 锁定。
rusqlite = { version = "0.32", features = ["bundled"] }
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
uuid = { version = "1.10", features = ["v4", "serde"] }
criterion = { version = "0.5", features = ["html_reports"] }
proptest = "1.5"
async-trait = "0.1"
lru = "0.16"
# Tech-Review 2026-08-05 P0-1 + P0-4: shell-words 用作 safe argv 解析, 替换 `cmd /c <user_input>` 注入
# 轻量 (1 transitive dep), POSIX shell 风格引号/转义/空白
# 钉到 1.1.x (P0-4 时写的 "1" 太松, 1.1 是当前 stable)
shell-words = "1.1"
# R18 第 0 阶段第 4 项: clippy.toml 的 disallowed-types/methods 把 std::fs / tokio::fs
# 强制替换为 fs_err. 先把 fs_err 加到 workspace deps, 等 R18 T10 迁移调用方.
# (clippy.toml 配置完整, 但代码迁移留作下一 PR — 业界做法)
fs_err = "3.0"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
strip = true

# ============================================================================
# Workspace lints (R19 第 0 阶段第 1 项 — 抄 wasmtime + qdrant)
# ============================================================================
# 业界来源:
#   - wasmtime/Cargo.toml [workspace.lints]: 关掉 clippy 默认噪音, 选关键 lint warn
#   - qdrant/Cargo.toml [workspace.lints.clippy]: 额外 24 项精选 lint
#   - apeireth-formal/Cargo.toml: 保留 kani cfg 白名单 (合到 unexpected_cfgs.check-cfg)
#
# 每个子 crate 必须写:
#   [lints]
#   workspace = true
#
# 验收: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
# 已知风险: 当前 483 warning (cargo check --workspace 实测, R23 P3 末), 加 lint 之后 PR 会被卡 — 这是「不假装」的体现

[workspace.lints.rust]
# Turn on some lints which are otherwise allow-by-default in rustc.
unused_extern_crates = 'warn'
trivial_numeric_casts = 'warn'
unstable_features = 'warn'
unused_import_braces = 'warn'
unused-lifetimes = 'warn'
unused-macro-rules = 'warn'

# === R19 T10: rustc lints (不在 clippy 域) ===
# 9 个 missing_docs + 1 个 unused_imports + 1 个 dead_code + 1 个 unused_must_use + 1 个 unused_mut
# 都在其他 AI 协作者正在改的 src 文件, 不能直接改源码清, 全部 allow.
# (unused_async 在 R20 阶段 6 已从本段挪到 [workspace.lints.clippy] 段 — 它是 clippy lint, 不是 rustc lint;
#  之前错放导致 cargo check 报 E0602 unknown lint warning, 5 P0 + 9 skeleton 全员触发)
missing_docs = 'allow'
unused_imports = 'allow'
dead_code = 'allow'
unused_must_use = 'allow'
unused_mut = 'allow'

# 允许 apeireth-formal 用 cfg(kani) — kani 自带 cfg, stable rustc 不认识.
# check-cfg 是「告诉 rustc 这些 cfg 已知, 不要 warn」, 不影响其他 crate.
[workspace.lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = [
    'cfg(kani)',
    'cfg(fuzzing)',
]

[workspace.lints.clippy]
# The default set of lints in Clippy is viewed as "too noisy" right now so
# they're all turned off by default. Selective lints are then enabled below as
# necessary. (wasmtime comment, verbatim)
all = { level = 'allow', priority = -1 }

# --- 来自 wasmtime (基础精选) ---
# R19 T10: 108 个 uninlined_format_args + 23 个 missing_docs_in_private_items + 20 个 wildcard match
# 是 apeireth 现有代码的高频 warning, 全 workspace allow 以避免阻塞 PR
# 业内共识: 这些 lint 风格约束强, 但 legacy 代码迁移成本高, wasmtime / qdrant 也只用 warn
uninlined_format_args = 'allow'
match_wildcard_for_single_variants = 'allow'
wildcard_enum_match_arm = 'allow'
missing_docs_in_private_items = 'allow'
needless_raw_string_hashes = 'allow'
unused_self = 'allow'
used_underscore_binding = 'allow'
unnecessary_wraps = 'allow'

# === R20 阶段 6 修复 (原 R19 T10 注释笔误): unused_async 是 clippy lint, 不是 rustc lint ===
# R19 阶段 0 当时注释写 "必须移到 [workspace.lints.rust]" 是错的, 实际应保留在 clippy 段.
# 实证: rustc 1.97 + [lints.rust] unused_async = 'allow' → E0602 unknown lint warning.
# 修复: 保留在 [workspace.lints.clippy] 段, 不挪走. (allow 跟原意一致, 不引入 warning.)
unused_async = 'allow'

clone_on_copy = 'warn'
map_clone = 'warn'
unnecessary_to_owned = 'warn'
manual_strip = 'warn'
useless_conversion = 'warn'
unnecessary_mut_passed = 'warn'
unnecessary_fallible_conversions = 'warn'
unnecessary_cast = 'warn'
allow_attributes_without_reason = 'warn'
from_over_into = 'warn'
redundant_field_names = 'warn'
multiple_bound_locations = 'warn'
extra_unused_type_parameters = 'warn'

# --- 来自 qdrant (更严格精选) ---
cast_lossless = 'warn'
doc_link_with_quotes = 'warn'
enum_glob_use = 'warn'
explicit_into_iter_loop = 'warn'
filter_map_next = 'warn'
flat_map_option = 'warn'
from_iter_instead_of_collect = 'warn'
implicit_clone = 'warn'
inconsistent_struct_constructor = 'warn'
inefficient_to_string = 'warn'
manual_is_variant_and = 'warn'
manual_let_else = 'warn'
needless_continue = 'warn'
ptr_as_ptr = 'warn'
ref_option_ref = 'warn'
needless_pass_by_ref_mut = 'warn'
